note: State beach campground at Dana Point on the south end of Doheny State Beach, with a row of premium beach-side sites on the sand. The gate is locked 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. and late arrivals are not admitted. Winter flooding has been a problem. --Claude
summary: Doheny SB: open, $50/$65 confirmed (extra vehicle $15); 107 bookable sites on ReserveCalifornia (brochure 113, stored 118), max 40 ft; no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, water, dump; max stay 14. Booking window cut to 3 months; a temporary closure for rebuilding is anticipated 2027-2029. Bayfront confirmed (beach-side premium sites on open sand ~30-45 m from the high-water line).
